steps.text: 5:57 A.M. \ Cloudy \ Visibility: 17 km
Desert; 4 km from the outskirts of Lungmen
4 days after the Chernobog rescue mission

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}. You have currently been sleeping for 99999----

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Although your reluctance to leave bed is not beyond reason, your presence is urgently needed at the operations command room.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: Furthermore, here is some medical advice from Dr. Kal'tsit: Please keep the windows open to maintain a source of fresh air, and spend some time on the deck to maintain healthy levels of Vitamin D.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Doctor! Good morning.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: So you made it, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, are you feeling better now?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You looked like you were still in pain and and couldn't move around well yesterday.

options: I've made a complete recovery. How about you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm perfectly fine and full of energy today!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, we still have other missions to take care of...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So the sooner we can start preparing, the better. Doctor, you should get used to having to shift gears quickly here.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor,

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even though we sustained heavy losses in Chernobog, we gained a lot of information about Reunion and, more importantly, got you out alive.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Based on the negotiations we had yesterday, the closest nomadic city to us, Lungmen, has offered us a cooperation pact and agreed to exchange information with us.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We have some evidence that Reunion might be targeting Lungmen next.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We'll have to wait for Dr. Kal'tsit's permission first before we can get the rest of the information. She's still stationed within Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lungmen has granted us permission to temporary camp near the city. They've also agreed to compensate a portion of our losses and expenditures during the operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In exchanges, Rhodes Island is expected to help defend the city's outskirts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the reason why I called for you so early is...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Let me explain it, Amiya.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Last night, we discovered another wave of Chernobog survivors making their way towards Lungmen. They're expected to get there in the afternoon.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We'll be expected to safeguard the outskirts of District 5 just like the last few days. Only this time, there might be more Reunion members mixed into the group.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Because the situation is a bit different, we'll need to discuss some new tactics with you before beginning the operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Anyway, Doctor, there's a lot to get through today, so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's do our best!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: In any case...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Both of you, please complete your combat preparations. Doctor, once you've decided on your squad assignments, please let the operators know so that they also have time to prepare.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We'll set out 15 minutes after you finish your drills.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Oh, and make sure you're not late this time.
